card.name: Middle of the word ibuprofen
card.fires_on: The piece "upro" inside the drug name ibuprofen (Ib-upro-fen), in drug label text about NSAIDs, ibuprofen lysine injection, and ibuprofen with famotidine.

modes.label: Ibuprofen at sentence start
modes.description: Capitalised Ib followed by upro at the start of a sentence or product name.

modes.label: Ibuprofen mid-sentence
modes.description: Lower-case ib followed by upro after words like including or of.
modes.example: including ib<<upro>>fen and famotidine tablet, at
